Coram: Bharati Dangre, J.
 Dated : 12th July, 2022
P.C:-
1

The applicant seek protection from arrest in the wake of the order passed by this Court in case of co-accused Manoj Gholap, on 11/7/2022.
2

Recording that the applicant is arraigned as an accused in the very same C.R, which invoke Sections 328, 188,
272, 73 r/w Sec.34 IPC and Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act along with Section Section 65(E) of the Bombay Prohibition Act, 1949, the applicant deserve a similar protection by way of ad-interim order.

Hence, the following order :-

entities.text: Sanket Naresh Mistry vs State Of Maharashtra on 12 July, 2022 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (a) By way of ad-interim order, in the event of his arrest, the Applicant - Sanket Naresh Mistry in connection with C.R.No.837/2022 registered with Kasturba Marg Police Station shall be released on bail on furnishing P.R. bond to the extent of Rs.25,000/- with one or two sureties of the like amount.

(b) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with facts of case so as to dissuade him from disclosing the facts to Court or any Police Officer and should not tamper with evidence.

(c) The Applicant shall report to the Police Station from 14/7/2022 to 16/7/2022 between 2.00 p.m to 5.00 p.m and render all his co-operation to the Investigating Officer.
3
